vocabulary.example: This house is bigger than mine.
This is the biggest city in Korea.
She is as tall as her brother.
This restaurant is better than that one.
It's not as cold as yesterday.
My brother is older than me.

grammar.explanation_en: Short adjectives add '-er' + 'than' for comparisons (bigger than) and 'the' + '-est' for superlatives (the biggest). Long adjectives use 'more' + 'than' (more expensive than) and 'the most' (the most expensive). Some are irregular: good→better→the best, bad→worse→the worst.
grammar.explanation_ko: 짧은 형용사는 '-er' + 'than'으로 비교급을(bigger than), 'the' + '-est'로 최상급을(the biggest) 만듭니다. 긴 형용사는 'more' + 'than'(more expensive than)과 'the most'(the most expensive)를 씁니다. 일부는 불규칙합니다: good→better→the best, bad→worse→the worst.

examples.en: This bag is cheaper than that one.
She is the tallest student in class.
examples.ko: 그녀는 반에서 가장 키가 큰 학생이에요.

examples.en: Today is not as hot as yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: Which phone is better, this one or that one?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: This one is better, but it's more expensive.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: Is it the most expensive phone here?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: No, that black one is the most expensive.

reading.title: Choosing an Apartment
reading.text: I am comparing two apartments. Apartment A is bigger than Apartment B, but it is also more expensive. Apartment B is not as big, but it is closer to my office. I think Apartment B is the better choice for me because I want a short commute.
reading.text_ko: 저는 두 아파트를 비교하고 있어요. A아파트는 B아파트보다 크지만, 더 비싸요. B아파트는 그만큼 크지는 않지만, 회사에서 더 가까워요. 저는 출퇴근 시간이 짧기를 원하기 때문에 B아파트가 저에게 더 나은 선택인 것 같아요.

explanation.en: The text says 'Apartment A is bigger than Apartment B.'
The text says Apartment B 'is closer to my office.'
The text says 'because I want a short commute.'
explanation.ko: 본문에 'I want a short commute'라고 나옵니다.
